description.en: Settings-page skill editor for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: edit a skill's SKILL.md body and frontmatter description in place. Local skills (in ~/.dsh/skills, ~/.agents/skills, or the workspace .dsh/skills) are freely editable; bundled/built-in skills are read-only with a warning. Saving writes the SKILL.md to disk immediately and skills are hot-loaded without restarting dsh.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 设置页直接编辑技能 SKILL.md 的正文与 frontmatter 描述：本地技能（~/.dsh/skills、~/.agents/skills、工作区 .dsh/skills）可自由编辑保存，系统/内置技能只读并给出风险提示；保存后立即写盘，技能热加载、无需重启 dsh。
